declined.reason: There is no code left in this context to judge. Its context-map row has file_paths: [], and .ai/registry-map.json lists paths: []. Its two entry points, src/features/fleet/monitor/triage/MonitorProjectColumns.tsx and src/features/fleet/monitor/triage/triageModel.ts, no longer exist. The directory src/features/fleet/monitor/triage/ is absent, and `git ls-files` turns up no triageModel, MonitorProjectColumns or PersonaGlyph under src/features/fleet. Git history shows the deletion: commit f21ecd8b36 (2026-08-26) removed 72 lines from triageModel.ts, and commit b1d59f8aa8 (2026-08-26, 'header becomes the router') deleted MonitorProjectColumns.tsx (209 lines) and PersonaGlyph.tsx (45 lines). src/features/fleet/monitor/grid/fleetGridModel.ts:154-157 confirms it: the operation-badge logic was 'Moved here (2026-08-26) from the retired `triage/triageModel.ts`, whose only consumer — the Project-columns view — was deleted'. That code now belongs to the Activity grid context, not this one. Calling the pair not-applicable would be wrong, because the context did not avoid HITL concerns: it was a review and input-gate surface, and it was removed. Any anchor I gave would be borrowed from another context.
